name: How long does restoration service take?
description: Restoration service duration varies based on damage severity, from a few days for minor issues to several weeks for extensive damage.

mainEntity.name: How long does restoration service take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of restoration service depends on the severity and type of damage. Minor water damage might take a few days, while extensive fire or storm damage requiring significant reconstruction could take several weeks or even months. A restoration company can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific situation.
